terminalContract: The evaluator returns one immutable issue/evidence result for the first failing compiler-declared uniform input range. Inspector and runtime consume that same evaluation, retaining no raw source path or content beyond a repeated byte and declared offsets. A report records only evidence whose exact issue instance occurs once in its final Issues list, through a zero-based index and bound slot id; absent evidence serializes as absent. Input acceptance, severity, BlocksBuild, profiles, output bytes, names, execution order, and report creation outside real Preview/Build remain unchanged.
